summary: Animated ads reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds; last 4 posts got zero engagement. Bio incorrectly niches to Himachal/hotels and promises 24hr delivery.
guidance:
- Hook style: try question or contrast hooks (highest relative engagement) instead of top3/curiosity used recently.
- Avoid repeating "static vs motion" or "captions ignored" angles; they've appeared twice with low response.
- Keep skip rate low: front-load visual motion + a clear pain point in first 2 seconds (e.g., "Your ad pauses the scroll because it moves").
- Posts must read like a developer sharing a real build, not an ad — show code snippet or timeline, not promises.
- Use national hashtags only (#SmallBusinessIndia #AIAdvertising #DigitalMarketingIndia).

instructions.research: Find 3 Indian small businesses (different cities/industries) running static image ads on Instagram; note their ad format and engagement clues.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two past animated_ads posts (static-vs-motion, pov-feed) — list exact hook, first 3 seconds visual, and engagement metrics.
instructions.writer: Draft a question-hook post for animated ads: open with a relatable pain point (e.g., 'Ever boost a post and hear crickets?'), explain how motion grabs attention in feed, end with 'pay after approval' DM invite.
instructions.image: Create a split-screen static vs animated ad mockup (generic product, no brand) showing motion blur effect; keep it clean, code-editor background visible.
instructions.video: Record a 15-second screen capture of you animating a simple banner in After Effects/Canva — no narration, just workflow; caption with the same question hook.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to remove niche/region references, 24hr claim, and free offer; replace with national, service-agnostic description.
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian small business pages (cafes, gyms, clinics) about their ad struggles — no self-promo.
Share today's animated ads post to relevant LinkedIn groups for freelancers/agencies with a brief insight, not a pitch.
